name: Cavik
source:
Cavik is a Jut Qou Obesk who worked in the Embassy in the Call Research Initiative alongside Akizet.

He previously worked on the "life-pod" project before transferring to Call Research. Akizet and Cavik have been friends since they were larval, and it is implied he gave her the cyst that allowed her to ascend and become a Qou.

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Cavik]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]

Cavik is a Jut Qou Obesk who worked in the Embassy in the Call Research Initiative alongside Akizet.

He previously worked on the "life-pod" project before transferring to Call Research. Akizet and Cavik have been friends since they were larval, and it is implied he gave her the cyst that allowed her to ascend and become a Qou.
